Indico Developments · Request for quotation · Package 06

Sanitaryware, taps and showers

Katembe Ocean Views, Katembe, Maputo, Mozambique. A building with 12 T3, 3 T2 and 2 compact T2 apartments, a restaurant on floor 4, a supermarket, parking, a club house and a pool.

The plans below show where every item goes, with sizes from the architect's model. The table at the end lists each item, its specification and the quantity to price.

What we need from you

  1. A price per item number (supply only, and supply and install if you offer it).
  2. Lead time and stock availability.
  3. Delivery to Maputo, or collection in Johannesburg.
  4. Quote validity, payment terms and warranty.

Bathroom and kitchen elevations, setting out and specification

Every bathroom wall below is drawn from the architect's 3D model, seen from inside the room. Red numbers are the item numbers in the price table. Heights above finished floor in mm. All visible metal is matt black. Where a model differs from ours, offer it with its data sheet.

Sanitaryware and taps: specification for every item

FinishMatt black on every visible metal item (PVD or powder coat), coastal environment: state the finish warranty
ToiletFabia Khroma FA-979 smart wall hung toilet or equal: touchless lid, bidet and rear wash, air dry; needs a socket behind; concealed frame for a 230 mm wall, plate 200 × 200 matt black
Basins and mixersVessel basin 400 to 450 mm white matt on floating oak vanity; tall single lever mixer, spout about 220 above the basin
ShowersConcealed thermostatic mixer, rain head D 320 on wall arm at about 2170, hand shower on riser; tiled tray with linear or point drain (by others)
KitchenUndermount stainless sink 800 × 460 single bowl, pull out tap about 380 high, matt black
AccessoriesHeated towel rail 500 × 800 with timer, robe hooks, roll holder, brush holder, towel ring or bar, squeegee and niche shelf: all matt black, same range
WaterMains pressure about 3 bar with hot water from electric geysers: confirm the minimum pressure of each item; 15 mm connections, isolating valves included
Setting outWC pan, top of seat 950 mm (top); Flush plate 1130 mm (centre); Vanity top / basin rim base 910 mm (top); Basin mixer spout top 1230 mm (top); Shower thermostatic mixer 1160 mm (centre); Rain shower head 2200 mm (bottom); Heated towel rail 630 mm (bottom); Mirror 1480 mm (centre); Kitchen worktop 940 mm (top); Kitchen tap top 1290 mm (top)
